nodes.label: Seed Admin Handler
nodes.rationale: Uses constant-time comparison and in-memory rate limiting to protect the admin seed endpoint from timing attacks and brute force.

nodes.label: Next.js (Agents Context)
nodes.rationale: This version has breaking changes. APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from training data. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. Heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: graphify
nodes.rationale: Before answering architecture or codebase questions, read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure. Navigate wiki/index.md instead of raw files when available. Prefer graphify query/path/explain over grep for cross-module questions. Run graphify update . after code changes.
